entries.title: Print labels from recent Parts imports
entries.description: Print labels immediately after importing new Parts, or find the import later under Print labels → Recent imports. You can also include updated Parts, using their current details.

entries.title: Identify operators and bays more easily
entries.description: Scheduling screens and dashboard widgets now show operator names first, with bay names alongside them. Bays without an operator are clearly marked.

entries.title: Enlarge product images and logos
entries.description: Click image previews to inspect them at a larger size. Upload controls now show file limits, loading progress and errors beside the image.

entries.title: Preview supplier documents before uploading
entries.description: Drag and drop supplier invoices and credit notes, then preview the PDF before uploading. File problems and missing return selections are explained beside the controls.

entries.title: Import the correct CSV after replacing a file
entries.description: Choosing an unsupported replacement now clears the previous file and its import preview, preventing an accidental import of the earlier selection.

entries.title: Find profile image controls more easily
entries.description: Upload and replace buttons now sit beside the image preview. If an image cannot be processed, the error stays beside the controls.

entries.title: Identify operators and bays more easily
entries.description: Bay lists, queues and job routes now display operator and bay names consistently, without repeating the operator name. Bays without an operator are clearly marked.
